answer: The ripple is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the comet. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
